question: After the two correctness defects are fixed, should OpenClaw bundle an opt-in 1Password SecretRef provider that executes an operator-pinned external `op` binary with forwarded 1Password authentication environment?
rationale: The implementation mechanics are reviewable, but accepting a new bundled credential-execution boundary and external runtime dependency requires explicit repository product and security intent.

options.title: Approve bundled integration
options.body: Land the opt-in plugin after the findings are fixed and security owners approve the external CLI and shared-contract boundary.

options.title: Externalize the plugin
options.body: Keep the generic SecretRef plugin APIs while distributing the vendor-specific integration outside OpenClaw core.

options.title: Pause for common policy
options.body: Defer this PR until maintainers define a repository-wide policy for bundled external-CLI secret resolvers.

recommendation.title: Approve bundled integration
recommendation.body: Land the opt-in plugin after the findings are fixed and security owners approve the external CLI and shared-contract boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged history across the shared SecretRef contract and the adjacent bundled Vault integration, including its security and alias-hardening work.
